items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Die Frist für die Einlegung des Einspruchs beträgt einen Monat.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 27 Apr 2026, sent by ordinary post (einfacher Brief). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO the letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Fri 1 May 2026; since that day is a public holiday (Erster Mai) in NW, delivery is deemed to occur on the next business day, Mon 4 May 2026 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) starts counting the day after (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later on Thu 4 Jun 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). Thu 4 Jun 2026 is a public holiday (Fronleichnam) in NW, so the deadline shifts to the next business day, Fri 5 Jun 2026 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).

warnings: The 888.00 € tax refund (Erstattung) will be paid to the IBAN printed in the letter (DE21 4405 0199 0123 4567 89), which is well-formed and passes the checksum check, but this does not by itself confirm the account belongs to the recipient — compare it with account details from earlier correspondence with this Finanzamt if in doubt.
